[EN] Yet more arachnen shells?

[EN] Ex-shell-ent! Ha!

[EN] Hard Shells

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt arachnen {@linkcreature:39#130#matriarchs} and {@linkcreature:39#131#matrons} in the central lair. Collect their shells.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the shells to Paicha at Roughneck Outpost.
[ES] Entrega los caparazones a Paicha en el Puesto Forajido.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "As requested."
[ES] "Como lo pediste."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
